# NAMI Metro Baltimore

> NAMI Metro Baltimore provides mental health support, peer-led programs, and community advocacy across the Baltimore region.

NAMI Metro Baltimore is a local chapter of the National Alliance on Mental Illness serving Baltimore City, Baltimore County, Carroll County, and surrounding Maryland areas. The organization offers free support groups, educational classes, crisis resources, and stigma-reduction programs for individuals with mental health conditions, families, caregivers, youth, and workplaces.

## Key Topics

- Mental health support
- Support groups
- Peer-led programs
- Family support
- Youth programs
- Crisis helpline
- Community education

- Baltimore mental health advocacy
- Free mental health programs
- Mental Health Hubs
- NAMI Connection
- Family-to-Family
- Peer-to-Peer classes
- Mental health resources

## Crisis Support & Help

- [Get Help Now](https://namibaltimore.org/get-help-now): Crisis support and helpline resources including suicide prevention
- [Contact Us](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-are/contact-us): Contact information and support options for NAMI Metro Baltimore

## Core Programs & Services

- [Support Groups](https://namibaltimore.org/what-we-do/support-groups): NAMI Connection and Family Support Groups peer-led programs
- [Classes](https://namibaltimore.org/what-we-do/classes): Educational classes including Peer-to-Peer and Family-to-Family
- [Mental Health Hubs](https://namibaltimore.org/what-we-do/mental-health-hubs): Mental Health Hubs drop-in programs at community partner locations
- [Community Education](https://namibaltimore.org/what-we-do/community-education): Community education and stigma reduction presentations and programs

## Support by Audience

- [Individuals with Mental Health Conditions](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-serve/individuals-with-mental-health-conditions): Resources for individuals with mental health conditions and recovery
- [Family Members and Caregivers](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-serve/family-members-and-caregivers): Family support groups and caregiver resources and education programs
- [Youth & Young Adults](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-serve/youth-young-adults): Youth programs including Mighty Monsters and Ending the Silence
- [Workplaces](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-serve/workplaces): Workplace mental health programs and presentations for organizations

## About NAMI Metro Baltimore

- [Home](https://namibaltimore.org): Homepage for NAMI Metro Baltimore mental health support and advocacy
- [About NAMI](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-are/about-nami): About NAMI Metro Baltimore mission and services across Baltimore area
- [Our Impact](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-are/our-impact): Impact report and organizational achievements of NAMI Metro Baltimore
